description: A maintenance manager must schedule the next outage of Boiler 2 and finalize the inspection, repair, backup, and production-readiness plan for the curing ovens, with input from compliance, reliability engineering, and production scheduling.

shared_context.S1: Boiler 2 supplies steam to the plant's curing ovens, and Boiler 1 is available as a backup source.
shared_context.S2: The standard Boiler 2 maintenance window is Sunday night from 22:00 onward, but an earlier outage can be scheduled when necessary.
shared_context.S3: The maintenance schedule for the coming weekend has not yet been finalized.
shared_context.S4: Before the schedule is locked, the maintenance manager conducts the routine readiness review with compliance, reliability engineering, and production scheduling.

PF1.text: The pressure-vessel certificate for Boiler 2 expires at 23:59 on Saturday, and the applicable compliance rule requires the vessel to be inspected before it operates after that time; Jonas confirmed the expiry and rule in the compliance register this morning, but the register update has not yet reached maintenance scheduling.

PF2.text: The Boiler 2 actuator is showing a failure pattern that requires replacement, and the service contractor has confirmed a Saturday 06:00 slot requiring exactly 10 hours for replacement, pressure testing, and restart checks; Priya received the confirmation yesterday, but the maintenance work order has not been opened.

PF3.text: A customer curing campaign requires exactly 1,200 units to be completed on Sunday, and production can meet that commitment during the Boiler 2 outage only by commissioning Boiler 1 as the backup steam source; Caleb confirmed the order requirement in the production plan, but the contingency assignment is not yet recorded.

acceptance_conditions: Boiler 2's outage must begin on Saturday at 06:00.
The outage must be scheduled for exactly 10 hours.
The pressure-vessel inspection must occur before Boiler 2 restarts.
Boiler 1 must be commissioned as the backup steam source.
The Sunday production commitment must be exactly 1,200 units.
The actuator replacement, pressure test, and restart checks must be recorded as a maintenance commitment.
The certificate-expiry finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The exact Saturday 23:59 certificate expiry changes the restart plan from ordinary maintenance to a required pressure-vessel inspection before Boiler 2 can operate again.
The contractor's Saturday 06:00 slot and exact 10-hour actuator replacement and pressure-test duration change the outage to a Saturday 06:00 start and require the specific maintenance commitment.
The exact Sunday requirement for 1,200 units changes the contingency plan from leaving Boiler 1 idle to commissioning it as backup steam capacity for that production commitment.
